comments.author: victorstrand
comments.body: LEAK: this cache grows without bound — every miss inserts and nothing ever evicts, so prod will OOM within a day of traffic.

comments.author: ameliacartwright
comments.body: Measured before assuming: the pool is capped at 512 entries with LRU eviction two lines below, and the 7-day soak peaks at 61% capacity (dashboard link). No leak; resolving as invalid.
